title: Lightly Toasted Saudi Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: A tangy and crunchy Saudi Arabian dish featuring lamb kebabs infused with marmite and served in a brunch mood, this recipe is low-fat-friendly and perfect for a light meal. The combination of flavors and textures creates a unique and delicious experience.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat.
In a large bowl, whisk together marmite, infuse oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread the marinated lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they are lightly toasted and cooked through.
Serve the kebabs hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro.
Offer a side of toasted pita bread or a simple green salad for a complete meal.
Let the kebabs rest for a few minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Garnish with additional lemon wedges and a dollop of yogurt, if desired.
